classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a direct transcription of a parliamentary debate, created at the time of the event by the National Council.
classification.resume: The document is a parliamentary record of a debate in the Swiss National Council concerning a popular initiative for modern animal protection, recorded on 16 December 2005 during the winter session. It includes a speech by Claude Janiak and is part of the National Council's meeting protocols. The item is an audio recording of the proceedings.
